standard_prerequisites.use: First step: produces the variable y and the proof of forall y subst(A,c,y).

standard_prerequisites.name: Change of bound variable
standard_prerequisites.use: Second step: the biconditional forall x subst(A,x,c) iff forall y subst(A,y,c).

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1400-1405): if Gamma proves A, c does not occur in Gamma, and x is not free in A but free for c in A, then Gamma proves forall x subst(A,x,c).

Proof (lines 1407-1417): WeakGen gives y and Gamma proves forall y subst(A,c,y); since y is not in A at all it is not free in A and free for c in A, so with x also not free in A and free for c the change-of-bound-variable requirements hold, giving the equivalence of the two universal closures; monotonicity back to Gamma closes.
proof_roadmap: WeakGen to a fresh variable y.
Check the change-of-bound-variable hypotheses for x and y.
Transport along the equivalence; monotonicity closes.
difficulty_reason: Strong generalization (statement 1400-1405, proof 1407-1417): a three-step composition (WeakGen, hypothesis check, change-of-bound-variable equivalence) each named and applied. H2.
